blueprint: kept
state: { under_way: [], seen: [] }

on:
  begun:
    event: work.begun
    # one of them is under way from here
    do: keep
    with:
      in: under_way
      by: item
      what: { item: "${event.data.item}", called: "${event.data.called}" }

  over:
    event: work.over
    do: drop
    with:
      from: under_way
      by: called  # by what it was called
      is: "${event.data.called}"

  saw: { event: work.seen, do: keep, with: { in: seen, what: "${event.data.item}" } }
